official.description: KDI School, the graduate school of the Korea Development Institute in Sejong, offers the Seoul G20 Global Leaders Scholarship primarily to working professionals in the public sector and other potential global leaders, with the award decided by the school's Admissions Committee. The published benefits are a full tuition waiver, a monthly stipend and round-trip airfare, and there is no separate scholarship application - accepted students are considered through the ordinary admissions process.

applicant_utility.summary: This is an internal KDI School award for public-sector professionals from G20 or EU countries: it removes the 28,000,000 KRW Master's tuition (7,000,000 KRW per semester for four semesters) and adds a monthly stipend plus round-trip airfare, but KDI School never publishes the stipend figure, so budget against its own official estimate of about 1,000,000 KRW per month for on-campus living. You do not apply for the scholarship separately - it is decided by the Admissions Committee through the ordinary admissions route (document review, then a 10-15 minute Zoom interview), and only a limited number of students receive it. The Spring 2027 window closed on 14 August 2026 with final results on 19 October 2026, and the Fall 2027 Master's deadline has not been announced, so watch the admissions notice board and expect interviews around May-June. Work backwards from an English test taken within two years of the deadline, because a Medium of Instruction letter disqualifies the whole application.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Mid-career public-sector professionals from G20 or EU member states, or Korea Studies graduates, who already hold a Bachelor's degree and can produce sealed employment verification.
application_readiness_checklist: Count your public-sector service months precisely against your route: 1 year if you are a G20 national, 6 years if you are not, or rely on your Korea Studies degree instead
Book an accepted English test (TOEFL iBT, IELTS, OPIc, TEPS or Duolingo) at or above the minimum and dated within two years of the deadline - an MOI certificate is worthless here
Get your current employment verified on KDI School's own official form, signed by an HR officer or supervisor and stamped; appointment letters, contracts and pay slips are explicitly refused
Brief two recommenders early and insist on English letters - they must submit in the system before 24:00 KST on the closing day, and a missing letter ends your review
Check your passport runs to at least January 2028 for Master's applicants, and line up Apostille or Korean-consular legalization in the country where your degree was awarded
Prepare the formal 35x45 mm JPG photo (under 3MB) and complete the online survey before starting the formal application
common_rejection_risks: Submitting a Medium of Instruction certificate instead of one of the five accepted test scores - the school states this leads to automatic disqualification
Employment verification missing, unsigned, unstamped, or on the wrong form, which leaves your public-sector experience uncounted and undercuts the core eligibility route
Self-written or missing recommendation letters, or letters submitted after the closing-day cutoff - the application is excluded from evaluation
Incomplete academic history or data in the form that does not match your passport and certificates exactly
Applying before actually holding the degree (only Korean and Japanese expected graduates are exempt from this rule)
Failing to post Apostilled or consular-legalized documents so that they physically arrive by the published November deadline, which withdraws the admission offer
Having already held a Korean government scholarship at the same degree tier, which removes scholarship eligibility for the equivalent tier
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: KDI School's own estimate of on-campus monthly living costs is 1,000,000 KRW: shared double dormitory 200,000 KRW, meals 540,000 KRW, books and study materials 100,000 KRW, and insurance and miscellaneous expenses 160,000 KRW. The school supports only the student, so bringing a family means arranging and funding their accommodation and visas yourself, and the part-time international programme carries no visa or financial support at all.
document_audit: Employment verification must be on the official KDI School form only; previous employment needs standard documentary proof instead
Legalization must be done in the country where the degree was conferred, not where you currently live
Degrees from China must be issued by CHESICC/CHSI and consular-verified; if there is no Korean embassy in your country, use the embassy with jurisdiction over that region
Notarization, attorney certification or authentication by the issuing university alone is not sufficient for the visa-stage submission
Recommendation letters should be in English; Korean-language letters may not be reviewed properly
Non-English diplomas and transcripts need certified English translations alongside the Apostille or consular stamp
Unofficial graduation letters are rejected; provisional certificates are only valid if issued within one year before the semester starts
alerts: The award is limited in number and decided by the Admissions Committee - most international students receive full benefits, but this scholarship is competitive rather than automatic
The scholarship decision is announced with the final admission result and cannot be appealed
Admission and scholarship cannot be deferred under any circumstances; a deferral request revokes admission and forfeits the award
Dual citizenship including Korean nationality disqualifies you from applying as an international student at all
The Spring 2027 window is over; interviews for Fall admissions run in May-June, so document preparation and legalization need to start roughly a year before entry
Accept the visa reality early: the Ministry of Justice rules mean visa support only follows submission of properly legalized academic documents
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the online survey, then the online application with SOP at apply.kdischool.ac.kr, trigger the two recommendation requests, upload documents by the 18:00 KST closing time, and await document review, a Zoom interview, and the scholarship decision with the final admission result.
